points.description: Identifies the principal mechanism as biological removal / bio-filtration (biological action by microorganisms), not simple straining or sedimentation.
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely biological (e.g. 'biological action' without microorganisms) or mixes in physical straining as the main mechanism.

points.description: Explains that a thin biological layer (schmutzdecke / hypogeal layer) of microorganisms forms at the sand-water interface/top of the sand and removes particles/bacteria/viruses.
points.partial_credit: Half if the layer is named or described but its location or role is missing or slightly wrong.

rubric.notes: Full marks: bio-filtration identified as the main mechanism and the schmutzdecke (biological layer on top of the sand) named or described as doing the removal. Part marks: only one of the two ideas, or a vague answer such as 'biological layer' with no detail. No marks for answers naming only physical processes (sedimentation, straining, adsorption) as the principal mechanism.
